Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Report means of every recorded telemetry signal for those pools and applied changes during 10:00–12:00 (kind, pool, effective time, before/after JSON strings). arguments.command:
cat > /tmp/q.py <<'PY'
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('../data/current.db'); c.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
for period,a,b in [('reference',1778148000000,1778151600000),('incident',1778151600000,1778155200000)]:
 sql='''with ops as (select o.operation_id,ra.pool_id,pr.deadline_ms from logical_operations o join service_routes r using(route_id) join route_assignments ra on ra.route_id=o.route_id and o.opened_at_ms>=ra.effective_from_ms and o.opened_at_ms<ra.effective_to_ms join policy_profiles pr using(profile_id) where r.service_id=2 and o.opened_at_ms>=? and o.opened_at_ms<?), x as(select ops.*,count(a.attempt_id) n,sum(case when f.is_success=0 then 1 else 0 end) bad,max(a.attempt_no) mx from ops join attempt_events a using(operation_id) join failure_codes f using(code_id) group by operation_id), last as(select x.*,a.queue_ms,a.execution_ms,f.is_success from x join attempt_events a on a.operation_id=x.operation_id and a.attempt_no=x.mx join failure_codes f using(code_id)) select p.pool_code,count(*) operations,sum(is_success=0) terminal_failures,avg(is_success=0)*100 terminal_pct,sum(n) attempts,sum(bad) failed_attempts,100.0*sum(bad)/sum(n) attempt_pct,sum(n>1) retried,min(deadline_ms),max(deadline_ms),avg(case when is_success=0 then queue_ms end),avg(case when is_success=0 then execution_ms end) from last join worker_pools p using(pool_id) group by pool_id'''
 print(period,[tuple(r) for r in c.execute(sql,(a,b))])
 print('tele', [tuple(r) for r in c.execute('select p.pool_code,s.signal_code,avg(value),s.unit from telemetry_samples t join worker_pools p using(pool_id) join telemetry_signals s using(signal_id) where measured_at_ms>=? and measured_at_ms<? and p.pool_code like "sync-%" group by pool_id,signal_id',(a,b))])
PY
python /tmp/q.py
